user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with only a title and no optional fields so that minimal input is sufficient.

positive.title: Create a task with a valid title
steps: Enter a valid title into the 'Title' field
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the provided title.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with an empty title
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that the title is required, and the task is not created.

negative.title: Attempt to create a task with a title that exceeds the character limit
steps: Enter a title into the 'Title' field that exceeds the character limit
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that the title exceeds the character limit, and the task is not created.

edge.title: Create a task with a title exactly at the character limit
steps: Enter a title into the 'Title' field that is exactly at the character limit
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the title at the character limit.
